annotation.summary_en: Three friends reunite to reminisce about their medical internships and discuss their marriages to much older, high-ranking men.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a living room where three women, two of whom are played by male actors in drag, are sitting on a couch and gossiping. One woman, wearing a pink satin robe and a blonde curly wig, serves fruit while reminiscing about their medical school internship days. They laugh about a prank they played on a 'dork' gynecologist named Martin Georgievich, whom they locked in a girl's bathroom. The conversation shifts to their current lives three years later. One friend reveals she married a 65-year-old professor; when asked how she manages the age gap, she jokes that his young students, PhD candidates, and handsome masters students handle her 'needs.' The second friend reveals she married a 70-year-old colonel, noting that she has an entire regiment of sergeants, officers, and handsome privates at her disposal. The sketch ends when they ask the first woman about her life, and she quips that she is just as 'spoiled' as they are, she just isn't married.
catchphrases: ֊Դե ես էլ եմ փչացածի մեկը, Ուղղակի Ամուսնացած չեմ։
